0.name: Average Income, Average Spending
0.description: The middle-ground majority with balanced earning and spending habits, forming the steady backbone of foot traffic.
0.strategy: Maintain consistent promotional campaigns, rewards for repeat visits, family-friendly events, and seasonal sales.

1.name: High Income, High Spending
1.description: High earners who spend lavishly. They value premium brand experiences, exclusivity, and luxury services.
1.strategy: Target with VIP loyalty tiers, luxury launches, personalized shopping concierges, and early-access privileges.

2.name: Low Income, High Spending
2.description: Younger, style-driven shoppers with modest earnings but high desire for fashion, entertainment, and trendy products.
2.strategy: Engage with flash sales, flexible Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) options, trend-focused social campaigns, and influencer partnerships.

3.name: High Income, Low Spending
3.description: Affluent individuals who are highly selective and price-conscious despite substantial income.
3.strategy: Attract with high-value propositions, durable quality assurances, smart investments, and discreet promotions.

4.name: Low Income, Low Spending
4.description: Price-sensitive customers who strictly budget their visits and purchase essentials only.
4.strategy: Provide clear discount coupons, bundle deals, bulk savings, and practical everyday value messaging.
